n_7.source: Exact n=7 diagonal-coinvariant sign-quotient coefficients plus q<->t symmetry; SL2 endpoint reconstruction completes all strings and matches the type B area and diagonal constraints.

n_8.source: Exact n=8 boundary diagonal-coinvariant sign-quotient coefficients plus q<->t symmetry; 506 SL2 strings are read from endpoints and the remaining 20 are the unique nonnegative SL2 completion matching the type B area and diagonal constraints.

convention: Each sl2 string (shift, length) contributes (qt)^shift [length]_{q,t} with [length]_{q,t}=q^(length-1)+q^(length-2)t+...+t^(length-1). Gamma records use length = n^2 - 2*r - 2*shift + 1.
description: Type B q,t-Catalan polynomials for n=7,8 reconstructed from exact Hilbert coefficients and the observed SL2-string pattern. These are data artifacts and do not change qt_catalan_type_b, which remains source-backed only for n<=6.
source: n=7 uses exact known bidegrees in type_b_qt_catalan_n7_known_partial.json. n=8 uses exact boundary bidegrees in type_b_qt_catalan_n8_known_partial.json and a unique SL2 completion checked against the type B area specialization and diagonal q-binomial constraint.
